query: France Ebola case 2026: current status of the doctor who tested positive after aid mission, any secondary cases, ECDC reporting. How many confirmed Ebola cases in France as of July 2026?
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's a summary of my findings:

**Direct answer:** As of July 2026, there is **exactly 1 confirmed Ebola case in France**, with **zero secondary cases**.

**Key findings:**
- **The case:** France confirmed its first-ever Ebola case on national soil on **June 24, 2026** — a humanitarian doctor with the NGO **ALIMA** who had treated Ebola patients in the DRC and flew to France on a commercial Air France flight on June 23, 2026. This was the first Ebola case confirmed in Europe / to test positive outside Africa during the current Bundibugyo-strain outbreak.
- **Doctor's current status:** **Fully recovered and discharged** on **July 4, 2026**, after two negative PCR tests (announced by Health Minister Stéphanie Rist). The patient was almost asymptomatic apart from headaches.
- **Secondary cases:** **None.** Five fellow flight passengers were identified as contacts and isolated as a precaution; no infections resulted.
- **ECDC reporting:** The weekly CDTR and ECDC's dedicated Ebola outbreak page (last updated July 17, 2026) log the France case as one imported case with no onward EU/EEA transmission. Two other European imported cases were US citizens evacuated to Germany (May and July 2026) — separate from France.
- **Outbreak context:** DRC reached 2,124 confirmed cases / 828 deaths (July 15); Uganda 20 cases / 2 deaths.
